sections.title: باب 3 — متن (182)

paras.text: 12. Protection of students in foreign lands
paras.urdu: ۱۲۔ دیارِ غیر میں طلباء کی حفاظت
paras.pashto: ۱۲. په پردیو هېوادونو کې د زده‌کوونکو ساتنه

paras.text: Today in the academic world an important issue which Muslims face is the protection of the Muslim students gone to non-Muslim countries. Because today Muslim students there are declared terrorists, or their educational series is cut off in the middle. In such a situation it is the responsibility of the Muslim Ummah that it send its young students to non-Muslim countries with protective measures, and get them complete rights of living there, so that the students there may complete their educational activities in the best manner and return to their own countries safely and soundly.
paras.urdu: آج کل علمی دنیا میں جو ایک اہم مسئلہ مسلمانوں کو درپیش ہے وہ غیر مسلم ممالک میں گئے ہوئے مسلمان طلباء کی حفاظت ہے۔ کیونکہ آج کل مسلمان طلباء کو وہاں پر دہشت گرد قرار دیا جاتا ہے یا ان کے تعلیمی سلسلے کو درمیان میں منقطع کیا جاتا ہے۔ ایسے میں امتِ مسلمہ کی ذمہ داری ہے کہ وہ اپنے نوجوان طلباء کو غیر مسلم ممالک میں حفاظتی اقدامات کے ساتھ بھیجیں اور وہاں پر ان کو رہنے کے مکمل حقوق دلوائیں تاکہ وہاں پر طلباء اپنی تعلیمی سرگرمیاں احسن طریقے سے پوری کر کے واپس اپنے ملکوں کو خیر و عافیت کے ساتھ لوٹ سکیں۔
paras.pashto: نن په علمي نړۍ کې یوه مهمه ستونزه چې مسلمانان ورسره مخ دي، نامسلمانو هېوادونو ته د تللو مسلمانو زده‌کوونکو ساتنه ده. ځکه نن مسلمان زده‌کوونکي هلته ترهګر بلل کېږي، یا یې تعلیمي لړۍ په منځ کې پرې کېږي. په داسې حال کې د اسلامي امت مسؤلیت دی چې خپل ځوان زده‌کوونکي نامسلمانو هېوادونو ته د ساتنې د اقداماتو سره ولېږي، او هلته د اوسېدو بشپړ حقونه ورته ترلاسه کړي، تر څو زده‌کوونکي هلته خپل تعلیمي فعالیتونه په غوره ډول بشپړ کړي او په روغ رمټ خپلو هېوادونو ته ستانه شي.

paras.text: For progress in scientific sciences, research centres hold basic importance. Therefore as many research centres as possible should be established, so that scientific sciences can be promoted and new inventions can take place in science and technology.
paras.urdu: سائنسی علوم میں ترقی کے لیے ریسرچ سینٹرز بنیادی اہمیت رکھتے ہیں۔ اس لیے زیادہ سے زیادہ ریسرچ سینٹرز قائم کیے جائیں تاکہ سائنسی علوم کو فروغ دیا جا سکے اور سائنس اور ٹیکنالوجی میں نئی نئی ایجادات ہو سکیں۔

paras.text: Along with establishing research centres, seminars too should be arranged on various topics, in which benefit can be taken from the knowledge and experiences of various researchers, investigators and scholars, and everyone can get the opportunity to become aware of new sciences and concepts.
paras.urdu: ریسرچ سینٹرز کے قیام کے ساتھ ساتھ مختلف عنوانات پر سیمینارز کا بھی اہتمام کیا جائے جس میں مختلف ریسرچرز اور محققین و علماء کے علم و تجربات سے فائدہ اٹھایا جا سکے اور نئے نئے علوم و تصورات سے سب کو آگاہی کا موقع مل سکے۔

paras.text: 15. Use of media and new technology
paras.urdu: ۱۵۔ ذرائع ابلاغ اور نئی ٹیکنالوجی کا استعمال
paras.pashto: ۱۵. د رسنیو او نوې ټکنالوژۍ کارول

paras.text: Computers and scientific inventions have erased distances by making this world a Global Village. These media and new technology should be used for the promotion of knowledge. These inventions should be used for academic progress instead of time-wasting pursuits.
paras.urdu: کمپیوٹر اور سائنسی ایجادات نے اس دنیا کو Global Village بنا کر فاصلے مٹا دیے ہیں۔ ان ذرائع ابلاغ اور نئی ٹیکنالوجی کو علم کے فروغ کے لیے استعمال کیا جائے۔ ان ایجادات کو فضول وقت ضائع کرنے والے مشاغل کی بجائے علمی پیش رفت کے لیے استعمال کیا جائے۔
paras.pashto: کمپیوټر او ساینسي اختراعاتو دا نړۍ Global Village (نړیوال کلی) کړې او واټنونه یې له منځه وړي. دا رسنۍ او نوې ټکنالوژي دې د علم د ودې لپاره وکارول شي؛ دا اختراعات دې د وخت ضایع کوونکو بوختیاوو پر ځای د علمي پرمختګ لپاره وکارول شي.

paras.text: 16. Publication and protection of the academic services of Muslims
paras.urdu: ۱۶۔ مسلمانوں کی علمی خدمات کی اشاعت و حفاظت
paras.pashto: ۱۶. د مسلمانانو د علمي خدمتونو خپرول او ساتنه

paras.pashto: مسلمانانو چې کوم علمي خدمتونه سرته رسولي، منظم خپراوی دې یې وشي او ساتنه دې یې وشي، تر څو د راتلونکي لپاره د مسلمانو علماوو او ساینسپوهانو علمي خزانې خوندي شي.

sections.theory:
12. Protection of students in foreign lands

Today in the academic world an important issue which Muslims face is the protection of the Muslim students gone to non-Muslim countries. Because today Muslim students there are declared terrorists, or their educational series is cut off in the middle. In such a situation it is the responsibility of the Muslim Ummah that it send its young students to non-Muslim countries with protective measures, and get them complete rights of living there, so that the students there may complete their educational activities in the best manner and return to their own countries safely and soundly.

13. Establishing research centres

For progress in scientific sciences, research centres hold basic importance. Therefore as many research centres as possible should be established, so that scientific sciences can be promoted and new inventions can take place in science and technology.

14. Arranging various seminars

Along with establishing research centres, seminars too should be arranged on various topics, in which benefit can be taken from the knowledge and experiences of various researchers, investigators and scholars, and everyone can get the opportunity to become aware of new sciences and concepts.

15. Use of media and new technology

Computers and scientific inventions have erased distances by making this world a Global Village. These media and new technology should be used for the promotion of knowledge. These inventions should be used for academic progress instead of time-wasting pursuits.

16. Publication and protection of the academic services of Muslims

The academic services which Muslims have accomplished should have regular publication and dissemination, and they should be protected, so that the academic treasures of Muslim scholars and scientists may be preserved for the future.

د څېړنیزو مرکزونو تر څنګ دې پر بېلابېلو موضوعګانو سیمینارونه هم جوړ شي، چې په کې د بېلابېلو څېړونکو، محققینو او علماوو له علم او تجربو ګټه واخیستل شي، او ټولو ته د نویو علومو او تصوراتو سره د بلدتیا فرصت برابر شي.

۱۵. د رسنیو او نوې ټکنالوژۍ کارول

کمپیوټر او ساینسي اختراعاتو دا نړۍ Global Village (نړیوال کلی) کړې او واټنونه یې له منځه وړي. دا رسنۍ او نوې ټکنالوژي دې د علم د ودې لپاره وکارول شي؛ دا اختراعات دې د وخت ضایع کوونکو بوختیاوو پر ځای د علمي پرمختګ لپاره وکارول شي.

۱۶. د مسلمانانو د علمي خدمتونو خپرول او ساتنه

مسلمانانو چې کوم علمي خدمتونه سرته رسولي، منظم خپراوی دې یې وشي او ساتنه دې یې وشي، تر څو د راتلونکي لپاره د مسلمانو علماوو او ساینسپوهانو علمي خزانې خوندي شي.
sections.content:
12. Protection of students in foreign lands

Today in the academic world an important issue which Muslims face is the protection of the Muslim students gone to non-Muslim countries. Because today Muslim students there are declared terrorists, or their educational series is cut off in the middle. In such a situation it is the responsibility of the Muslim Ummah that it send its young students to non-Muslim countries with protective measures, and get them complete rights of living there, so that the students there may complete their educational activities in the best manner and return to their own countries safely and soundly.

13. Establishing research centres

For progress in scientific sciences, research centres hold basic importance. Therefore as many research centres as possible should be established, so that scientific sciences can be promoted and new inventions can take place in science and technology.

14. Arranging various seminars

Along with establishing research centres, seminars too should be arranged on various topics, in which benefit can be taken from the knowledge and experiences of various researchers, investigators and scholars, and everyone can get the opportunity to become aware of new sciences and concepts.

15. Use of media and new technology

Computers and scientific inventions have erased distances by making this world a Global Village. These media and new technology should be used for the promotion of knowledge. These inventions should be used for academic progress instead of time-wasting pursuits.

16. Publication and protection of the academic services of Muslims

The academic services which Muslims have accomplished should have regular publication and dissemination, and they should be protected, so that the academic treasures of Muslim scholars and scientists may be preserved for the future.

sections.text:
۱۲۔ دیارِ غیر میں طلباء کی حفاظت

آج کل علمی دنیا میں جو ایک اہم مسئلہ مسلمانوں کو درپیش ہے وہ غیر مسلم ممالک میں گئے ہوئے مسلمان طلباء کی حفاظت ہے۔ کیونکہ آج کل مسلمان طلباء کو وہاں پر دہشت گرد قرار دیا جاتا ہے یا ان کے تعلیمی سلسلے کو درمیان میں منقطع کیا جاتا ہے۔ ایسے میں امتِ مسلمہ کی ذمہ داری ہے کہ وہ اپنے نوجوان طلباء کو غیر مسلم ممالک میں حفاظتی اقدامات کے ساتھ بھیجیں اور وہاں پر ان کو رہنے کے مکمل حقوق دلوائیں تاکہ وہاں پر طلباء اپنی تعلیمی سرگرمیاں احسن طریقے سے پوری کر کے واپس اپنے ملکوں کو خیر و عافیت کے ساتھ لوٹ سکیں۔

۱۳۔ ریسرچ سینٹرز کا قیام

سائنسی علوم میں ترقی کے لیے ریسرچ سینٹرز بنیادی اہمیت رکھتے ہیں۔ اس لیے زیادہ سے زیادہ ریسرچ سینٹرز قائم کیے جائیں تاکہ سائنسی علوم کو فروغ دیا جا سکے اور سائنس اور ٹیکنالوجی میں نئی نئی ایجادات ہو سکیں۔

۱۴۔ مختلف سیمینارز کا اہتمام

ریسرچ سینٹرز کے قیام کے ساتھ ساتھ مختلف عنوانات پر سیمینارز کا بھی اہتمام کیا جائے جس میں مختلف ریسرچرز اور محققین و علماء کے علم و تجربات سے فائدہ اٹھایا جا سکے اور نئے نئے علوم و تصورات سے سب کو آگاہی کا موقع مل سکے۔

۱۵۔ ذرائع ابلاغ اور نئی ٹیکنالوجی کا استعمال

کمپیوٹر اور سائنسی ایجادات نے اس دنیا کو Global Village بنا کر فاصلے مٹا دیے ہیں۔ ان ذرائع ابلاغ اور نئی ٹیکنالوجی کو علم کے فروغ کے لیے استعمال کیا جائے۔ ان ایجادات کو فضول وقت ضائع کرنے والے مشاغل کی بجائے علمی پیش رفت کے لیے استعمال کیا جائے۔

۱۶۔ مسلمانوں کی علمی خدمات کی اشاعت و حفاظت

مسلمانوں نے جو علمی خدمات سرانجام دی ہیں ان کی باقاعدہ نشر و اشاعت ہو اور ان کی حفاظت کی جائے تاکہ آئندہ کے لیے مسلمان علماء اور سائنسدانوں کے علمی خزانے محفوظ ہو سکیں۔

sections.theory:
17. Ending terrorism

In the present era terrorism has further increased the difficulties of Muslims, from which generally Muslim countries themselves are being affected. The irony is that non-Muslim countries themselves fan terrorism, entrapping Muslims in it, and they themselves are also blamed. In these circumstances the Muslim Ummah should, instead of emotions, act with intellect, consciousness, wisdom and planning, so that the resources of Muslim countries are used in academic progress and the move of the enemy fails.

By acting upon all these responsibilities we can again get the Muslim Ummah a high position in the world of knowledge, and in the future can take the Ummah to those very high stages of progress on which it was in the era of the Banu Abbas and in Andalus.

5. Possible efforts of individuals and the collective for the spread of knowledge; the map of the future and the attitude of the Ummah

In today's era no one can deny the importance of knowledge. Man was sent into the world as a vicegerent. Allah the Exalted had told this very importance at that time when …

For this the important matter is that first of all every individual should acquire knowledge. He should consider it the first duty of his life. In this way, if every individual of the Ummah is educated, then certainly society will be prosperous. Muslims will be successful in every field of life. Not only one individual, one group, one region or country will be prosperous, but its effect will fall upon the whole Ummah and the future will be better.

In the spread and acquisition of knowledge, the individual and the collective will have to try that not only should they keep their religious inheritance preserved and absorb it within themselves, but worldly sciences too have to be acquired. In it economic, social, scientific — all kinds of sciences — are included.

علم کی اشاعت اور حصول میں فرد و اجتماع کو یہ کوشش کرنی ہوگی کہ نہ صرف اپنے دینی ورثہ کو سنبھال کر رکھنا ہے اور اس کو اپنے اندر سمونا ہے بلکہ دنیاوی علوم کو بھی حاصل کرنا ہے۔ اس میں معاشی، معاشرتی، سائنسی تمام طرح کے علوم شامل ہیں۔

sections.content:
17. Ending terrorism

In the present era terrorism has further increased the difficulties of Muslims, from which generally Muslim countries themselves are being affected. The irony is that non-Muslim countries themselves fan terrorism, entrapping Muslims in it, and they themselves are also blamed. In these circumstances the Muslim Ummah should, instead of emotions, act with intellect, consciousness, wisdom and planning, so that the resources of Muslim countries are used in academic progress and the move of the enemy fails.

By acting upon all these responsibilities we can again get the Muslim Ummah a high position in the world of knowledge, and in the future can take the Ummah to those very high stages of progress on which it was in the era of the Banu Abbas and in Andalus.

5. Possible efforts of individuals and the collective for the spread of knowledge; the map of the future and the attitude of the Ummah

In today's era no one can deny the importance of knowledge. Man was sent into the world as a vicegerent. Allah the Exalted had told this very importance at that time when …

For this the important matter is that first of all every individual should acquire knowledge. He should consider it the first duty of his life. In this way, if every individual of the Ummah is educated, then certainly society will be prosperous. Muslims will be successful in every field of life. Not only one individual, one group, one region or country will be prosperous, but its effect will fall upon the whole Ummah and the future will be better.

In the spread and acquisition of knowledge, the individual and the collective will have to try that not only should they keep their religious inheritance preserved and absorb it within themselves, but worldly sciences too have to be acquired. In it economic, social, scientific — all kinds of sciences — are included.
